import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import os

# 设置工作目录路径
work_dir = '⟨workdir⟩'
db_path = os.path.join(work_dir, 'dacomp-085.sqlite')

    print(f"数据库文件不存在: {db_path}")
else:
    print(f"连接到数据库: {db_path}")
    
    # 连接到SQLite数据库
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    
    # 执行SQL查询
    query = """
    SELECT *,
           RANK()         OVER (ORDER BY days_as_worker) AS r,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_as_worker) AS pr,
           NTILE(100)     OVER (ORDER BY days_as_worker) AS pct_bucket
      FROM workday__employee_overview;
    """
    
    # 读取数据到pandas DataFrame
    print("正在执行查询...")
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    
    # 关闭数据库连接
    conn.close()
    
    print(f"查询完成，共获取 {len(df)} 行数据")
    
    # 显示前10行数据
    print("\n前10行数据:")
    print(df.head(10))

    # 显示描述性统计
    print("\n描述性统计:")
    print(df.describe())
    
    # 保存结果到CSV文件供下游分析使用

    df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"\n结果已保存到: {output_path}")
